subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

I think my **__malaise__ **is chiefly owing to the depressing influence of town air and town scenes.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Wellness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"malaise"** means a general feeling of discomfort, illness, or unease whose exact cause is difficult to identify. (अस्वस्थता)

 
 
• **Example: **After the long flight, he felt a sense of malaise and fatigue.
 
 
 
• **"Wellness" **refers to the state of being in good health, especially as an actively pursued goal. (स्वास्थ्य)
 
 
• **Example: **Regular exercise and a balanced diet are essential for maintaining wellness.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'malaise'** is **'wellness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Wellness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Disquiet **(बेचैनी): A feeling of worry or unease.

 
 
• **Example:** The news of the impending storm caused great disquiet among the residents.
 
 
 
• **Angst **(चिंता): A feeling of deep anxiety or dread.
 
 
• **Example: **Teenagers often experience angst about their future and identity.
 
 
 
• **Unease** (असुविधा): A state of discomfort or anxiety.
 
 
• **Example:** There was a sense of unease in the room when the CEO entered.
